entries.title: RimWorld
entries.definitive_edition: RimWorld on Windows PC with Royalty, Ideology, Biotech, Anomaly, and Odyssey DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with Royalty, Ideology, Biotech, Anomaly, and Odyssey DLC
primary.why: The PC release has the complete expansion path through Odyssey, strong mod support, and the best capture/input route. RimWorld Console Edition is playable on PS4 and Xbox One, but the console path is not the complete expansion route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy RimWorld on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, or the official Ludeon store for Windows PC, then add the Royalty, Ideology, Biotech, Anomaly, and Odyssey DLC for the current complete route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with the full PC expansion path and mod ecosystem.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete content route and best fidelity/capture/input platform.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Mac desktop release with the PC expansion path.
all_releases.reason: skip: same content family as PC; Windows PC remains the preferred capture/support route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Linux desktop release with the PC expansion path.
all_releases.reason: skip: same content family as PC; Windows PC remains the preferred capture/support route.

all_releases.fidelity: RimWorld Console Edition native PS4 release; playable on newer PlayStation hardware through compatibility.
all_releases.reason: skip: valid console route, but not the complete expansion/mod route compared with PC.

all_releases.fidelity: RimWorld Console Edition native Xbox One release; playable on newer Xbox hardware through compatibility.
all_releases.reason: skip: valid console route, but not the complete expansion/mod route compared with PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The highest-fidelity PC route is also the most complete route because it has the full DLC path through Odyssey; the console edition is less complete.

entries.remaster_caveats: RimWorld Console Edition is a separate console port/access route by Double Eleven. It is not a remaster and does not replace the PC route for complete expansion coverage.
